name: business-website-fullstack
description: Runs the Express API and the Next.js client together with a single command.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.setup:db: npm run prisma:migrate --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm start --prefix server" "npm start --prefix client"
scripts.build: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm build --prefix server" "npm build --prefix client"
